summary: Ran a consistency audit of every promoted fact against the receipts it cites, prompted by the direction error found last turn, and it caught one more transposition of the same kind: the client-change fact claimed the leader's own configuration entry sat at log index 110, but its receipt records index 106 — 110 belongs to the five-voter discard case, whose entry count and shape are similar enough to invite the confusion. The fact is corrected to index 106 with the premise note explaining where the wrong index came from, and the audit found every other fact's cited operands — voter counts, server sets, indices, payload presence, leader and term values, adoption counts and control outcomes — matching their receipts exactly, including the two reproductions of the partition result and the healed-partition observation. Nothing else changed: the question stays explained with the defect claim asserted, no gaps are open, and the remaining items are the recorded store and fault-model limitations. The account's facts now agree with their receipts on every operand I quoted.
